clauses.requirement: If visual inspection after the water-immersion test of retro-reflectors and retro-reflective marking materials (UN R150 Annex 6 Part 2, paragraph 1) does not reveal the presence of water, or in case of doubt, the further measurements specified in paragraphs 1.3.1 and 1.3.2 shall be carried out.

In the case of retro-reflectors, where visual inspection does not reveal water or in case of doubt, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 of UN R150, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.

In the case of a sample unit of retro-reflective marking, where visual inspection does not reveal water or in case of doubt, the coefficient of retro-reflection R' shall be measured in conformity with Part 2 of Annex 6, the sample unit being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
Advance warning triangles shall be tested in accordance with the test requirements of UN R150 Annex 6 Part 2, paragraph 2 (heading clause covering the tests for advance warning triangles).
The retro-reflective device or fluorescent retro-reflecting material of advance warning triangles shall be subjected to the resistance test specified in UN R150 Annex 6 Part 2, paragraph 2.1.

For the resistance test, the triangle (collapsible triangles assembled as for use) shall be immersed for 10 minutes in water at 50 °C ± 5 °C, with the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface about 20 mm below the water surface; immediately afterwards the retro-reflective device shall be immersed under the same conditions in water at 25 °C ± 5 °C.

After the immersion test, no water shall have penetrated to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflective device; if visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device has failed; water or water vapour penetration into the edges of fluorescent retro-reflecting materials shall not be deemed a failure.

If visual inspection does not reveal water, or in case of doubt, the RI shall be measured again under the same conditions as specified in paragraph 1.2 of Part 2 of Annex 6, after the retro-reflective device has been gently shaken to remove excess water from the outside; the RI shall not have diminished by more than 40 per cent of the values recorded before the test.
